heading.en: Calculating Total Cost at a Duka

body.en: To find your shopping bill, add the prices of all the items you want to buy.
body.sw: Ili kupata gharama ya ununuzi wako, jumlisha bei za vitu vyote unavyotaka kununua.

worked_example.en: A loaf of bread costs Ksh 65 and a packet of milk costs Ksh 55. Total: 65 + 55 = Ksh 120.

body.en: Change is the money given minus the total cost of goods. Subtract the bill from the money paid.
body.sw: Chenji ni pesa ulizotoa kutoa bei ya bidhaa. Toa jumla ya gharama kutoka kwa pesa uliyompa muuzaji.

worked_example.en: You buy goods for Ksh 140 and pay with a Ksh 200 note. Change: 200 - 140 = Ksh 60.
worked_example.sw: Umenunua vitu vya Sh 140 na kulipa noti ya Sh 200. Chenji: 200 - 140 = Sh 60.
